metadata.case_name: LIN CHIU LUNG v. ILE CO LTD

plaintiff.occupation_after: Limited employment in a sheltered workshop

injuries.description: fracture of the medial epicondyle of the right humerus
source: Mr Lin suffered a fracture of the medial epicondyle of the right humerus.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the elbow or forearm

source: Consequent upon that Mr Lin suffered right ulnar nerve entrapment.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of ulnar nerve at forearm level

injuries.description: adjustment disorder with prolonged depressive reaction
source: He has subsequently suffered a psychiatric condition described by the psychiatrist as adjustment disorder with prolonged depressive reaction.
diagnosed by Professor Felice Leih-Mak as suffering from a prolonged depressive reaction to the injury.

manifestations.description: pain in his liver, both shoulders, and the left side of his chest (reported by plaintiff)
preoccupation by perceived deformity of the right elbow
social isolation and not going out except for clinics or to the mainland seeking treatment
limited employment (working in a sheltered workshop) and inability to return to previous employment

treatments_received: A.&E. examination and x-ray at Eastern Hospital (25 November 1999)
Two surgical operations to relieve right ulnar nerve entrapment (first operation 19 June 2001; second operation 17 December 2001)
treatments_future: Day patient psychiatric rehabilitation five days a week for six months
20 sessions with a psychiatrist over one year
20 sessions of psychotherapy by a clinical psychologist over one year

losses.description: Social isolation; does not go out of his home other than to attend clinics or to the mainland seeking treatment.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Does not go out of his home other than to attend clinics or to the mainland seeking treatment.
Unable to return to previous employment as an electrician and has obtained only limited employment in a sheltered workshop.

He has subsequently suffered a psychiatric condition described by the psychiatrist as adjustment disorder with prolonged depressive reaction. diagnosed by Professor Felice Leih-Mak as suffering from a prolonged depressive reaction to the injury.
